title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive web applications using React and modern web technologies. Work with Google's cutting-edge tools and collaborate with world-class engineers.
requirements: Knowledge of React, CSS, HTML, and JavaScript. Experience with responsive design and Google's development standards.

title: Backend Developer
description: Develop robust backend APIs and manage database systems for Amazon's massive scale. Build microservices and work with cloud infrastructure.
requirements: Proficiency in Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. RESTful API design experience and AWS knowledge preferred.

title: Fullstack Developer
description: Work on both frontend and backend to build scalable applications on Microsoft Azure. Collaborate on enterprise-level projects.
requirements: Full-stack development expertise with React and Node.js. Azure experience is a plus.

title: UI/UX Designer

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze data sets to derive actionable business insights for GitHub's platforms. Work with massive datasets to drive product decisions.

title: Machine Learning Engineer

title: Cybersecurity Analyst

title: Product Manager
description: Lead product development from ideation to launch. Coordinate cross-functional teams to drive Twitter's vision forward.
requirements: Product management, Agile, and stakeholder management expertise. Social media platform experience preferred.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
We are seeking a talented UI/UX Designer to craft visually appealing and user-friendly digital experiences. You will collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to translate requirements into intuitive designs.

Responsibilities:

Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes

Conduct user research and usability testing

Develop and maintain design systems and style guides

Work with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs

Optimize designs for different devices and platforms
requirements:
- Proven experience as a UI/UX designer

Strong portfolio showcasing web and mobile designs

Proficiency in design and prototyping tools (Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch)

Understanding of responsive design principles

Good communication and collaboration skills

Bonus: Experience with front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS)

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
description: We are seeking a passionate Frontend Developer with hands-on experience in React. You will be responsible for building responsive user interfaces, improving website performance, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver seamless user experiences. The ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving skills and a good understanding of modern JavaScript frameworks.
requirements:
Strong knowledge of React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3

Understanding of state management (Context API/Redux)

Experience with REST APIs

Basic knowledge of Git and version control

Good communication skills and willingness to learn

Bonus: Experience with Tailwind CSS or Material UI
